_about: Region trials (D-042 slice 12, AUTO_COVERAGE_DESIGN.md 10): one place a member could live, run end to end on STAGING by .github/workflows/region-trial.yml. home: the point a test member saves (collector_note_home_point, so tile demand and the event region come exactly as from a real home save, with no user id). views: map views [west, south, east, north] the report reads as a signed-out visitor, from Postgres and from the static files. hubs: hub chips (slugs) each view is also read with. searches: place name searches run on the files the app read.
